versions.subject: feat: update rules related to onenote and more
fix: add missing modified and improve test
Merge PR #4427 from @nasbench - Multiple Fixes & Enhancements
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
        # Note: add more common locations for drops such as download folders and the like. Or baseline legitimate locations and alert on everything else
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
        - ':\Temp\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.one'
        - '.onepkg'
filter_main_onenote:
    Image|contains: ':\Program Files\Microsoft Office\'
    Image|endswith: '\ONENOTE.EXE'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: TargetFilename IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*:\\Temp\\*") TargetFilename IN ("*.one", "*.onepkg") NOT (Image="*:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\*" Image="*\\ONENOTE.EXE")
